verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe extending Obsidian with community-built plugins for features the core app lacks, such as extra file formats and third-party integrations, and note a Restricted Mode toggle that gates third-party code (obsidian-docs-31, obsidian-docs-7, obsidian-docs-27). Community users corroborate an active plugin ecosystem, citing Dataview, Text-Generator, Git, and a CRDT collaboration plugin (obsidian-comm-5, obsidian-comm-7, obsidian-comm-8). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the in-app browse/install catalog flow, and evidence of the catalog's size.
